delivery.title: Across Azerbaijan. Free.
delivery.intro: Delivery anywhere in Azerbaijan is completely free. Courier, metro meetup, Azerpost — it doesn't matter, there's never an extra charge. Because your gift should arrive on time.

courier.title: Courier delivery
courier.desc: Delivered within Baku, Absheron and Sumgait. Orders are prepared and delivered within 3 days.

metro.title: Metro station meetup
metro.desc: Delivered to any Baku metro station — completely free. A dedicated time slot is arranged for you, on the day and hour that suits you.

regions.title: Azerpost (Regions)
regions.desc: Delivered to any region of Azerbaijan via Azerpost — completely free.

s3.title: Quality check
s3.desc: Every item is checked before shipping

f1.a: Yes, every delivery method is completely free. Courier (Baku, Absheron and Sumgait), metro station meetup (any station), and Azerpost (all regions) — all free of charge.

f2.a: The courier delivers your order on your chosen day. The exact time is set based on order sequence for that day. For example, if you choose August 12th, it will be delivered that same day.

f3.q: What is a metro station meetup?
f3.a: Delivery to any Baku metro station — completely free. A dedicated time slot is arranged for you, on the day and hour that suits you.

f4.q: How does delivery to the regions work?
f4.a: Everything outside Baku is shipped via Azerpost. Delivery is completely free. You'll receive a notification to pick it up from your local post office.

f5.q: How long does an order take to prepare?
f5.a: Preparation takes 1 business day. On day 2 it's packaged and handed to the courier. Delivery happens on day 3, or on the day you choose. You'll be notified once your order is ready.

f6.a: Cancellation is possible before laser engraving begins. Once engraving has started, cancellation isn't possible — a personalized item can't be resold to another customer.

about.seoDesc: Ravio — a Baku-based shop for personalized gifts. Laser engraving, free delivery, 5% of every sale goes to stray animals. Every item is made specially for you.
about.heroBody: Ravio is a personalized gift shop based in Baku. Every item is laser-engraved to order. 5% of every sale goes toward stray animals. Delivery is completely free.

p1.label: Delivery philosophy
p1.title: Free across Azerbaijan
p1.body: We don't charge for delivery — not in Baku, not in Sumgait, not anywhere in the country. Courier, metro meetup, Azerpost — three channels, all free. Because choosing a gift and then facing a delivery fee takes away the joy of that gift.

p2.label: Animal welfare philosophy
p2.title: 5% of every sale to stray animals
p2.body: 5% of every gift you buy automatically goes toward feeding, treating, and sheltering stray animals. This isn't a promotion — it's built into how our business works. When you buy a gift for someone you love, you're also doing good for someone else.

p3.label: Personalization philosophy
p3.title: Every gift, in your name
p3.body: Using laser technology, we engrave a name, date, message, even coordinates onto every item. What you buy doesn't look like it came from a store — it looks like it came from your heart. Nothing is mass-produced — every order is made, checked, and packaged individually.
